## Found while implementing #530

Code trace: `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/rocknix/sources/scripts/usbgadget` assigns `devversion=0x$(echo $OS_VERSION | cut -b 3-6)`, expecting a calendar version such as20241025, and writes it to configfs bcdDevice. The already shipped0.0.1 value produces `0x0.1`; a prerelease suffix also fails the four-BCD-digit contract. This predates #530 but must not be missed while detaching the new naming scheme from old behavior.

Already written: existing0.0.1 firmware has the invalid derived value on this path. No cloud/save/settings mutation is involved; this investigation does not call the live gadget or claim a physical USB test.

Can this be done on the VM? Numeric derivation, shell controls and a simulated configfs write can be verified on the host/VM. Real USB enumeration is a separate hardware observation, not a reason to touch the owner's in-use devices.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Choose a documented valid bcdDevice revision source independent of semantic release text, preserving vendor/product/serial identity; retained controls cover old calendar metadata and current semantic/prerelease metadata.
- [x] Source trace and executable guest proof show a valid four-digit BCD value at the configfs write without changing normal USB modes; record exact source and remaining physical observation explicitly.
- [ ] The next assembled candidate includes the correction and its installed-byte proof before claiming the USB path qualified.

M7.P5 follow-up to #265/#530 before the next RC qualification. No physical action is authorized by this issue.

## Implementation and proof plan — 2026-10-11

The maintainer: "Let’s be sure to document this working list. Then, let’s begin on 531 and start working through it."

Use a shared fixed USB device revision `0x0100` (BCD 1.00), independent of all OS_VERSION text. This revision describes the gadget interface, not the OS release. Both actual prepare_usb_network and prepare_usb_mtp retain their existing IDs, strings, configuration attributes and function links. No new package/runtime dependency or settings migration. Normal prepare/boot paths regenerate transient descriptors; no owner device operation is needed to apply this source change.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes: run tools/usb-gadget-test on the host and an isolated GENERIC_X64 guest, executing the actual assignment and full preparation function bodies in disposable filesystem fixtures. Cover calendar, semantic, dev, RC, build metadata, oversized semantic, arbitrary and absent release values; retain old-source failures and exact hashes. The current guest kernel has CONFIG_USB_GADGET disabled, so the fixture proves shell writes and descriptor invariants, not kernel acceptance, UDC binding or physical enumeration. Linux configfs.c separately checks numeric conversion and each BCD nibble; the source trace is retained.

The standard watch-build-submit/watch-build recorder plus active session polling within60seconds will supervise guest setup/proof/retirement and deliver the terminal result here. No disconnected notification is claimed. First two criteria stay open until original outputs are consumed; the final assembled-image criterion stays open for the combined candidate. Working list: #531, #532/#533, product-affecting #528 choices, then combined #529/#530/#531 installed QA and release gates in M7.


## Source qualification — 2026-10-11

The shared `0x0100` revision is implemented (D-WORKFLOW-160). Exact old/new
preparation bodies were exercised for nine version inputs in both networking
and MTP fixtures: old control 40/72 with expected exit1; corrected host sh,
host Bash and GENERIC_X64 guest sh each 72/72. IDs, strings, serial, network
addresses, mode attributes and links are preserved. Source and tool hashes
match; protected synthetic settings remain equal.

Guest01 failed before USB tests because the harness assumed optional
/proc/config.gz existed. All original five1s remain. Fresh guest02 uses the
exact frozen kernel config with the same fixture/assertions and passes all
five owner channels0. Actual launcher/runner/watcher/command/QEMU exits and
disk/UEFI/key retirement are recorded. No physical device/cloud action.

Evidence: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-usb-revision/README.md`, source-bindings.json,
SHA256SUMS and guest02/completion-consumption.json. Source delivery is being
recorded separately; this checks the first two source/fixture criteria only.
The next assembled-image criterion remains open. GENERIC_X64 disables the
USB gadget kernel facility: no kernel-write/UDC/host-enumeration/traffic claim.
The source correction leaves transient gadget state regenerated on normal
preparation; no persistent-data migration or new player workflow is needed.
issue.title: M7.P5: Decouple USB gadget revision from calendar OS versions

## Current priority — M7.P5 deliver qualified #531, then settle thin naming and reconcile scope before freeze

The owner has approved engineering firmware transfers and one reboot each for the RG35XX SP, RG SP and Retroid Pocket Nova, plus the named preparation and screenshot checks. #519's controlled RG35XX SP alignment is ACCEPTED before transfer: exact state-bound receipt, all163 protected files/recovery/credentials preserved, stale experimental records archived and automatic cloud sync disabled. Do not repeat alignment, builds, completed audits or VM qualification.

All three approved transfers, single reboots, installed-artifact checks, preservation comparisons and reviewed compositor frames are COMPLETE. RG35XX SP accepted15:24UTC, RG SP15:54UTC, Nova16:01UTC, followed by final preservation/frame review. Every original stage/reboot result channel is0 and actual owners exited. Both additional devices have been handed back for normal use. Those deployment/build/audit jobs have ended. The #529 VM investigation is complete; its source delta and next-candidate qualification are recorded below. Nova startup observations are retained under #344: one recovered frontend retry also occurs on the prior build; the early SMMU burst is not assigned a cause or frequency. No physical gameplay/audio claim.

### Current work in order

1. **#531 — source fix and host/guest controls qualified; complete source delivery.** Shared BCD revision0x0100 replaces calendar slicing. Actual networking/MTP preparation controls pass72/72 for nine version values, preserving identities and mode attributes; old-source failure retained. Original guest01 harness failure stays1; corrected guest02 original result channels0, actual process exits and scratch retirement verified. Evidence: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-usb-revision/`. First two criteria satisfied; next assembled-image installed-byte proof remains required. No physical USB test or new firmware build is claimed.
2. **#532 / #533 — settle naming and reconcile candidate scope before freeze.** #532 is a child of #265: define a thin public RC/release convention, without required alpha/beta stages; suggested 0.0.1-rc.1 then 0.0.1, retaining UTC/source build identity. Exact counter/promotion/default behavior is not yet selected. #533 is a child of #344: map every open M7 issue and open bug to original evidence or a specific missing assertion. Prioritize stale #352/#353 migration/discovery criteria and #349/#350/#337/#510/#354 status; never restore the retired move/follow flow to satisfy old checkboxes. Any real remaining defect belongs in this candidate's scoped fix list.
3. **#528 — resolve source/component choices that could change shipped content before freezing inputs.** Local source inventory/custody exists; 17 declaration gaps and per-file/vendor/special-input dispositions remain, including ABL implementation access and prebuilt provenance. Reconcile the new build's changed inputs rather than assuming the prior inventory qualifies them. Retrieval and off-host custody remain required before publication; they do not prevent an engineering image needed for proof.
4. **#344 / #529 / #530 / #531 — assemble and qualify the combined source.** #529 readiness fix is delivered at c6afa31db1c00ecd82ff615310f97debe63b519c; #530 identity at f10eec13067a69e3a5670a0879736801b40d2fc0, both original hosted checks passed. Their source/overlay proofs remain accepted; final image criteria stay open. Recheck #493 capacity/retention, freeze inputs, build under the standard active watcher, and verify installed fixes, clean/public ROCKNIX and retained-storage behavior, current metadata/INFORMATION frames and applicable release delta review. Carry prior evidence forward only with explicit unchanged-source scope. No completed audit transfer or device operation is automatically replayed.
5. **#528 / #344 / #265 / #359 — finish custody and release publication gates.** Independently retrieve/hash-verify source/assets and establish off-host custody; complete support/adoption/recovery notes and branding/source links. Apply separately qualified hardware/asset gates and named publication authority before any RC/public release claim. Thin naming does not weaken qualification.

**Completed device work:** #519 alignment and the authorized RG35XX SP, RG SP and Nova transfers/reboots/readbacks are complete. Devices are in owner use; automatic startup/game-exit sync remains off. No new physical action is authorized by this planning update.

**Parallel #511:** website/setup/ROM/BIOS guides stay in their separate Herdr lane; startup trust remains that lane's question. Local instructions work without a live site. **Personal #516:** optional residue cleanup remains separate; no bulk cloud cleanup or first sync is implied. #519 no longer awaits approval or execution.

## Completed qualification — retain, do not rerun

- **#510/#515/#520/#521/#522/#523:** settled post-rclone contract and finite layout disposition; preserve selected independent paths, no automatic cloud-folder move/follow. Source, target-native capture dependencies, explicit modes and reviewed flow/frame references are published. Unsupported ROM/BIOS layouts retain instructions. Linking a backend is not relocation consent (D-CLOUD-175/176/178/179).
- **#507/#524:** independent primary plus both approved Fable5.1/xhigh reviews, all four fixes, resolution evidence and exact-head hosted checks completed; both issues closed. Earlier candidate16 audit #471 also remains complete. Do not repeat external transfers.
- **#508/#526/#527:** final source/installed CF10/public-configuration preservation and real retained-storage upgrade are qualified. Replacement18 has13 unaffected standard suites plus separately qualified corrected walks and composed78-frame comparison. The original qa-21 aggregate rc1 remains unchanged; this is composed qualification, not a relabelled original run. WebDAV/SFTP/S3 each108 assertions (324total); candidate16→18 upgrade31checks. All16 corrected frames reviewed at640×480/1280×800; no baseline or blanket-mask change. Source/canonical flow/EN-FR branch evidence is retained.
- **#492:** H70002 and SM855003 engineering firmware and final inventories accepted; issue closed. Both use distribution `8b5113fa164ada7d002ab138b1e3a9bf795e9de5` and ES `1d76b3da7da75794066df1c089931b890304da7a`. H700 ARM244/aarch64671 and SM8550 ARM245/aarch64737 tasks completed. All original final build/acceptance channels0, actual owners/container exited. Original failed attempts remain failures. Those qualification jobs are complete; #529 is a separate startup investigation.

Qualification: [replacement18](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-pixelelated-replacement-18/qualification.md), [corrected walks](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-cloud-folder-walks), [device artifacts](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-device-refresh), [final inventories](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-final-inventory).

## Exact firmware and source custody

H70002 bundle `1b93642b24901b5c3a96b0a079d6fb4486ca30d213b4b2db890c6e3630404175`; TAR `b49cca4ca0b8996fa994181508c887d9df5afe155c9502919bab7bf7e153e39d`. Both DDR variants/update bytes,185 ARM handoff files, native helpers/catalog/post-update/identity pass.

SM855003 bundle `afcb966f246118798c87e59cd5bc6ce7c2c21167a5d712faea56393409d9d79d`; TAR `b3f1a8190e04abbf64d35486601ee19fce35d2d25bc7239b1be7cccd9fb43730`. Raw/update equality, GPT, all5 ABL files,187 ARM handoff files and14 FEX outputs pass. Two changed ARM outputs in each build differ only in bounded embedded revision/date/time strings; exact new bytes were accepted.

All2,327 component/profile rows (701 distinct components) map to local retained inputs:605 exact archives/9.04GB,372 Git snapshots,43 roots,439 submodule edges, frozen distribution recipes/patches and separately retained prebuilt sources. Only Teakra's unused test LFS payload is omitted with explicit source/build-edge disposition. This inventory is not complete corresponding-source/licence clearance.

The current notice basis is `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-09-notice-scope/licence-basis-corrected.json`.13of17 have some root/scoped evidence, not13 cleared components. GLSL's LGPL notice belongs to nnedi3, not the entire collection. Common/GLSL/RetroPie/slang shaders and ABL lack an established aggregate basis. rclone's embedded revision matches retained source but reports modified=true; Tailscale's version/tag evidence is not a reproducible-binary proof. ABL packaging is not implementation source; LinuxLoader `4588733123554b1f7bf935b04e494e4284894546` returned404 to blitterbot. Owner source/contact question remains pending; no upstream outreach occurred. IntendedB2 remains subject to the owner's comparison (D-WORKFLOW-107); no bucket or purchase inferred.

## Phase map and naming

| Phase | State | Evidence/remaining boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| M7.P0 — Tracking conventions | COMPLETE | #388/#389; milestone body is the ordered queue and open titles follow it. |
| M7.P1 — Safe migration and recovery | Historical source gate complete; folder move/follow superseded by #508 | #365/#356/#320/#391/#392 proofs retained. Settings recovery/locking remain required. |
| M7.P2 — Qualified release inputs | COMPLETE | #361/#362/#386, #310/#327/#332 software gates; proxy/dependencies and cut-time freshness retained. |
| M7.P3 — Build and qualify | COMPLETE software qualification | Candidate16 plus final replacement18 composed qualification; exact manifests, failure controls and upgrade/provider/frame receipts. |
| M7.P4 — Independent fixes audit | COMPLETE | #471 and later #507/#524 independent receipts; no repeat needed. |
| M7.P5 — Device and release completion | IN PROGRESS | Ordered work above; accepted firmware, authorized physical updates, remaining #528 and release/publication gates. |

M7-wide umbrellas #383/#344/#354 omit P. Other open titles use their owning phase. #344's historical contract P0–P6 headings are contract sections, not this execution queue. Closed titles stay historical. Prior migration-copy #502/#504/#505 evidence is superseded by #508, not authority to resume cloud migration. The complete prior milestone body is retained in the deployment tracking packet.

## Explicitly outside this release

Infrastructure topology/restore drill #347/#348/#355; replacement runner/inherited-code review #336/#339/#346; general audit-depth policy #378; device telemetry #387 and FOSS build-observability evaluation #432; disconnected notifications #395; RA fixture reset automation #464/#240; optional Dropbox/offsite QA #463; active-name cleanup #509; personal redundancy #518; broader site/trademark work. Existing release custody requirements still apply. D-INFRA-022 retains only immediate-test payloads plus durable compact evidence and required source custody. No RC designation or public publication clearance is claimed.
